partnerships: Only the invited operator can accept through the dashboard; invitation secrets are omitted from API responses and consumed on acceptance.
Email GET displays an escaped confirmation form without mutation. Acceptance requires explicit POST, the current token and the matching recipient email.
A revoked pair can be invited again through a conditional update, preserving its identity and historical references.
Revocation atomically deactivates affected legacy and multi-tour offers. Database guards prevent activation and new checkout without active partnerships.
Checkout checks partnership eligibility before holding slots or contacting a payment provider; a second database guard covers revocation races.
Failed invitation-email delivery is reported accurately while keeping the dashboard invitation.
changes.email_copy: Accessible copy icon beside email in the admin bookings Details column and individual booking customer details, with success and failure feedback.
changes.customer_panels: Opaque white panels and readable dark text for trip management, Profile, cancellation credit, voucher balance, contact, history and sign-in confirmation. Existing operator action colours remain.
